description: React component for displaying order success page, fetching order details based on URL params, and providing navigation options.

classes.name: OrderSuccess
classes.description: React component that displays order confirmation details, handles fetching order data on mount and update, and renders success or not found messages.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that fetches order data when component mounts, using order ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that refetches order data if the order ID in URL parameters changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the order success message, loading indicator, or not found message based on current state and props.
